description: List the MCP servers mcp-pin protects on this machine and whether any of them has a change waiting for review. Use it when the user asks which servers are pinned, or after mcp-pin blocked a server. No input. Returns, per server: id, label, tool and prompt counts, the date it was approved, and pending (true when a change is waiting). It never returns definitions or changed text. For a pending change, call mcp_pin_change_summary with its id, then ask the user to run "mcp-pin review <id>" in a terminal to read the diff.
name: mcp_pin_my_servers
title: Servers mcp-pin protects here
